answer: Sybil resistance needs identity to be costly and auditable at once. Each persona locks a stake that is forfeited if it is shown to be ivory-hollow, so cloning a fleet costs real value. Every honest agent's record accumulates on a shared island of signed history, where any peer can replay and detect duplicate creators. A sable-black list of proven fakes then blocks those identities from new rewards, keeping the economy one-human-one-agent by construction.
